basis: 690 confirmation cells x archived measured 203/322/561 s at n_files=4/8/16 (same pipeline and allocation as T22-S reduced) + 32 pilot cells; low/high from the archived per-cell median spread

sharding.why_not: serial fits the reviewed 72 h anchor within the measured spread; sharding requires a target-filesystem locking validation that does not exist, and the base instructions forbid speculative infrastructure expansion when serial meets the budget

lock_rewrite_note: no CephFS-safe ledger rewrite is implemented or depended on; the archived advisory flock is used serially. A parallel-safe ledger remains a separate reviewed engineering item (old F8), not a dependency of this science package
fallback: serial one-worker execution; failed cells are charged and retried only with --allow-repeat
rationale: R1 is the expected borderline case: ~73 h serial against a 72 h anchor (~3 days). It is decided SERIAL because it does not materially exceed the reviewed budget, the parallel alternative is unreviewed, and a failed locking claim would corrupt the ledger. If a later review approves a target-filesystem-validated parallel ledger, the wall time could fall to ~5 h but only as a separately tested engineering change.
